messages:
maya: Proposal — add a 'ramp_guard' block to canary config. Stops/pauses ramps if quality drops or samples are insufficient. Posting a small YAML example and some notes.

ton y: can you paste the YAML? where do you expect enforcement to live — gateway or rollout controller?

maya: ```yaml
canary: 
  percent_schedule: [5, 25, 50]  # minutes or manual steps
  evaluation_window: 300s
  min_samples: 100
  max_failure_rate: 0.02
  rollback_on_violation: true
```

liu: telemetry gotcha — if routing uses header overrides (x-redwood-test) we may bias which users get routed, so sample pools differ. need consistent hashing fallback and tagging so metrics aren't skewed.

zara: UX idea — Console rollout page should show live expected error rate with a CI band and a clear 'pause' CTA when guard trips. also show the sample size and a link to raw logs for the window.

sam: quota interaction question: if route-level token caps exist, a ramp could steal capacity from prod. we need admission control that respects global quotas or a per-tenant min-reserve.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created issue #4521: "ramp_guard API + gateway enforcement" — https://github.internal/rw/infra/issues/4521 (added maya, tony, liu).

tony: implementation note — prefer lightweight gateway checks: only evaluate rolling counts + a simple threshold check. controller should be the source of truth for config and trigger automated rollbacks. gateway must avoid heavy stats computation.

maya: agree. gateway does quick checks: ensure window_count >= min_samples and failure_rate <= max_failure_rate. if violated, return route-fallback header and emit an event. controller listens and flips the canary state if configured.

liu: metric suggestion: use Wilson score interval or Bayesian estimate instead of raw failure_rate when counts are low. Also expose "sample_bias_flag" when header-based routing changes cohort distribution.

zara: add an "experiment_log_window" flag to pump raw request IDs for X minutes for sanity checks. keep it off by default.

sam: caching edge-case — cached replies will inflate success count. tag cache_hit=true and ignore those in ramp metric.

maya: TL;DR for the PR: ramp_guard = {percent_schedule, min_samples, evaluation_window, max_failure_rate, rollback_on_violation, experiment_log_window}. I'll draft the RFC + console mock.

tony: sgtm. please add an emergency 'force' override gated by 2-person review and audit logging.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Note — any force override requires 2FA + audit entry per compliance. (react :eyes:)

maya: will do. opening WIP PR today. (react :thumbsup:)

zara: small follow-up — we should document how sampling bias affects A/B metrics; add a note to rollout docs.

maya: good call. adding docs + some unit tests for the gateway counter TTL edge cases.

sam: thanks — ping me for quota interaction tests.

(threads ends)
